capabilities: Create, rename, move, merge, reorder and delete folder-note node pairs
Browse a node's child nodes, media album and files in a sidebar
Explore the folder hierarchy in a 2D or 3D node graph
Create child nodes from selected text or unresolved links
Assign icons, colors and manual child order
disambiguation: Not a graph-view plugin; its Node Graph browses the folder hierarchy rather than links.
extras: Runs locally with no network requests; iOS compatibility unverified; requires Obsidian 1.12.7 or later; merge refuses ambiguous relative links instead of rewriting them.
intentEvidence: Keep using Obsidian's own File Explorer.
problem: Obsidian keeps folders and notes as separate things, so there is no single object that holds a folder's note, children and structure together.

relations.evidence: Matching periodic links are handled by Chrono Notes when its link creation is enabled.

summary: Turns each folder plus its same-named note into a managed node with a contents sidebar, hierarchy graph, icons and manual ordering.
